suspended_reason: The cause is a WHOLE-CHROMOSOME dosage change (an extra copy of chromosome 21), not a single-gene promoter switch. The emergence engine reads a promoter switch-threshold (gamma) per locus; a chromosomal aneuploidy is not a single-gene gamma shift, so there is no analyzable monogenic DNA read here. Held, per the author's rule (no analyzable single-gene DNA -> hold). A dosage-of-many-genes model is future work, not a v0.1.0 emergence.
